verdict.rationale: Antigravity ships an official terminal CLI. Its docs describe natural-language agent tasks, parallel agents, and slash commands for config, MCP, skills and hooks. They also cover a local sandbox that blocks ~/.ssh and .env, Vim editor mode, and headless mode for scripting and CI. A community user reports using the Antigravity CLI alongside VS Code and says it works fine. Missing for 10: documented CLI install/setup steps in the evidence, and deeper independent hands-on corroboration of local CLI use.
